decisions.executionNote: Cards read 1 and 9. Begin a slow elbow-up approach with the left closed gripper toward the first red button; keep right at home.
Continue smooth left-arm approach above the first red button, maintaining elbow-up continuity and clearance.
Advance left above red 0; begin preparing the right arm for blue confirmation without descending onto any button.
Finish left alignment at a clear hover over red 0; continue raising and positioning right toward blue.
Use wrist view to center left over red 0, then perform its single downward press. Right approaches blue at hover height only.
Finish the single red-0 depression and retract fully without a second contact. Complete right alignment above blue for the first confirmation.
Red 0 has had one down-and-up cycle. Press blue once to confirm this first count, keeping left clear and not touching the second red yet.
Release the first blue confirmation. Move left toward the center red button at clearance height; park right above and to the right, away from the left arm.
Align the left closed gripper over the center red button (card 9), approaching from above. Right stays safely raised; no additional blue contact.
Center red press 1 of 9: one controlled downstroke to the demonstrated press height, brief dwell, then full release. Right remains clear.
Center red press 2 of 9: one down-and-up cycle, including contact dwell and a settled release above the button.
Center red press 3 of 9: one vertical depression, brief dwell, and full release. Keep the right arm clear of blue.
Center red press 4 of 9: single downstroke to press height, dwell, then full upward release. Right remains stationary above clearance.
Center red press 5 of 9: one vertical down-and-up cycle with a contact dwell and full release; no blue contact.
Center red press 6 of 9: one depression with a brief dwell, followed by a full release above the button. Keep right clear.
Center red press 7 of 9: one controlled depression, brief dwell, and full release. Right stays clear of blue.
Center red press 8 of 9: one vertical downstroke, contact dwell, and full release. Keep right stationary and clear of blue.
Center red press 9 of 9: final single depression and full release. No further red presses; blue confirmation will follow after clearing the left arm.
Nine center-red cycles are complete. Clear the left arm toward home with elbow-up continuity; align right at a safe blue-button hover for the second confirmation.
Press blue once for the second confirmation after the ninth center-red cycle, then release fully. Continue returning the left arm toward its origin without further button contact.
Second blue down-and-up cycle is complete. Return both arms toward origin, opening the grippers and maintaining separated elbow-up paths with no further button contact.
Continue controlled return to origin with both grippers open. Reduce the left arm's remaining displacement and bring right back into its home-side workspace.
Finish returning both end effectors to their observed starting poses and let them settle, keeping both grippers open and avoiding any new button contact.
